היסטור masters
馝 חלקב אלב ולב וかもしれ we need to find the largest base \( b \) such that the sum of the digits of \( 12^5 \) in base \( b \) is not equal to 41.

### Step 1: Calculate \( 12^5 \) in base 10
\[ 12^5 = 248832 \]

### Step 2: Convert \( 248832 \) to base \( b \)
To find the digits of \( 248832 \) in base \( b \), we repeatedly divide by \( b \) and collect the remainders.

For example, in base 8:
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 8 &= 31104 \text{ R } 0 \\
31104 \div 8 &= 3888 \text{ R } 0 \\
3888 \div 8 &= 486 \text{ R } 0 \\
486 \div 8 &= 60 \text{ R } 6 \\
60 \div 8 &= 7 \text{ R } 4 \\
7 \div 8 &= 0 \text{ R } 7 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_8 = 740600_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 7 + 4 + 0 + 6 + 0 + 0 = 17 \), which is not 41.

### Step 3: Find the largest base \( b \) such that the digit sum is not 41
We need to find the largest \( b \) where the sum of the digits of \( 248832_b \) is not 41. Since the sum increases as the base increases, we can reverse-engineer the digit sum.

For \( b = 41 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 41 &= 6017 \text{ R } 21 \\
6017 \div 41 &= 146 \text{ R } 31 \\
146 \div 41 &= 3 \text{ R } 19 \\
3 \div 41 &= 0 \text{ R } 3 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{41} = 319321_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 3 + 1 + 9 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 20 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 40 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 40 &= 6220 \text{ R } 32 \\
6220 \div 40 &= 155 \text{ R } 20 \\
155 \div 40 &= 3 \text{ R } 35 \\
3 \div 40 &= 0 \text{ R } 3 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{40} = 335203_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 3 + 3 + 5 + 2 + 0 + 3 = 16 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 39 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 39 &= 6335 \text{ R } 3 \times 3 = 1 \text{ R } 3 \\
6335 \div 39 &= 161 \text{ R } 2 \times 3 = 2 \text{ R } 1 \\
161 \div 39 &= 4 \text{ R } 1 \text{ R } 3 \\
4 \div 39 &= 0 \text{ R } 4 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{39} = 41231_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 4 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 11 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 38 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 38 &= 6548 \text{ R } 8 \times 3 = 2 \text{ R } 8 \\
6548 \div 38 &= 172 \text{ R } 0 \\
172 \div 38 &= 4 \text{ R } 20 \\
4 \div 38 &= 0 \text{ R } 4 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{38} = 4208_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 4 + 2 + 0 + 8 = 14 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 37 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 37 &= 6720 \text{ R } 24 \times \frac{37}{37} = 2 \text{ R } 18 \\
6720 \div 37 &= 184 \text{ R } 20 \times 3 = 1 \\
184 \div 37 &= 5 \text{ R } 9 \text{ R } 7 \\
5 \div 37 &= 0 \text{ R } 5 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{37} = 57921_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 5 + 7 + 9 + 2 + 1 = 24 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 36 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 36 &= 6912 \text{ R } 7 \times 36 + 4 = 1 \text{ R } 8 \\
6912 \div 36 &= 192 \text{ R } 0 \\
192 \div 36 &= 5 \text{ R } 12 \times 3 = 1 \\
5 \div 36 &= 0 \text{ R } 5 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{36} = 5121_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 5 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 9 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 35 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 35 &= 7097 \text{ R } 7 \times 35 + 2 = 2 \text{ R } 10 \\
7097 \div 35 &= 202 \text{ R } 7 \times 35 + 1 = 1 \\
202 \div 35 &= 5 \text{ R } 22 \times 35 + 6 = 1 \\
5 \div 35 &= 0 \text{ R } 5 \times 35 + 0 = 0 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{35} = 51021_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 5 + 1 + 0 + 2 + 1 = 9 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 34 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 34 &= 7289 \text{ R } 7 \times 34 + 10 = 2 \text{ R } 8 \\
7289 \div 34 &= 213 \text{ R } 25 \times 34 + 17 = 1 \\
213 \div 34 &= 6 \text{ R } 21 \times 34 + 14 = 1 \\
6 \div 34 &= 0 \text{ R } 6 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{34} = 61421_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 6 + 1 + 4 + 2 + 1 = 14 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 33 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 33 &= 7546 \text{ R } 3 \times 33 + 10 = 1 \text{ R } 9 \\
7546 \div 33 &= 228 \text{ R } 22 \times 33 + 16 = 1 \\
228 \div 33 &= 6 \text{ R } 24 \times 33 + 12 = 0 \\
6 \div 33 &= 0 \text{ R } 6 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{33} = 16201_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 6 + 2 + 0 + 1 = 10 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 32 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 32 &= 7776 \text{ R } 16 \times 32 + 4 = 1 \\
7776 \div 32 &= 243 \text{ R } 0 \\
243 \div 32 &= 7 \text{ R } 25 \times 32 + 16 = 1 \\
7 \div 32 &= 0 \text{ R } 7 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{32} = 17071_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 7 + 0 + 7 + 1 = 16 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 31 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 31 &= 7994 \text{ R } 16 \times 31 + 20 = 1 \\
7994 \div 31 &= 257 \text{ R } 25 \times 31 + 1 = 0 \\
257 \div 31 &= 8 \text{ R } 9 \text{ R } 20 \\
8 \div 31 &= 0 \text{ R } 8 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{31} = 8901_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 8 + 9 + 0 + 1 = 18 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 30 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 30 &= 8294 \text{ R } 22 \times 30 + 10 = 1 \\
8294 \div 30 &= 276 \text{ R } 14 \times 30 + 10 = 1 \\
276 \div 30 &= 9 \text{ R } 6 \text{ R } 10 \\
9 \div 30 &= 0 \text{ R } 9 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{30} = 96101_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 9 + 6 + 1 + 0 + 1 = 17 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 29 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 29 &= 8580 \text{ R } 12 \times 29 + 15 = 1 \\
8580 \div 29 &= 296 \text{ R } 8 \times 29 + 14 = 1 \\
296 \div 29 &= 10 \text{ R } 6 \text{ R } 14 \\
10 \div 29 &= 0 \text{ R } 10 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{29} = 106141_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 0 + 6 + 1 + 4 + 1 = 13 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 28 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 28 &= 8880 \text{ R } 4 \times 28 + 7 = 1 \\
8880 \div 28 &= 317 \text{ R } 4 \times 28 + 8 = 1 \\
317 \div 28 &= 11 \text{ R } 9 \times 28 + 15 = 0 \\
11 \div 28 &= 0 \text{ R } 11 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{28} = 119481_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 1 + 9 + 4 + 8 + 1 = 24 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 27 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 27 &= 9249 \text{ R } 3 \times 27 + 9 = 1 \\
9249 \div 27 &= 342 \text{ R } 9 \times 27 + 16 = 0 \\
342 \div 27 &= 12 \text{ R } 18 \times 27 + 12 = 0 \\
12 \div 27 &= 0 \text{ R } 12 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{27} = 112181_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 8 + 1 = 14 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 26 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 26 &= 9562 \text{ R } 18 \times 26 + 10 = 1 \\
9562 \div 26 &= 367 \text{ R } 19 \times 26 + 15 = 0 \\
367 \div 26 &= 14 \text{ R } 7 \text{ R } 16 \\
14 \div 26 &= 0 \text{ R } 14 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{26} = 147161_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 4 + 7 + 1 + 6 + 1 = 19 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 25 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 25 &= 9953 \text{ R } 7 \times 25 + 24 = 0 \\
9953 \div 25 &= 398 \text{ R } 9 \text{ R } 19 \\
398 \div 25 &= 15 \text{ R } 19 \text{ R } 14 \\
15 \div 25 &= 0 \text{ R } 15 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{25} = 151914_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 5 + 1 + 9 + 1 + 4 = 21 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 24 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 24 &= 10368 \text{ R } 0 \\
10368 \div 24 &= 432 \text{ R } 0 \\
432 \div 24 &= 18 \text{ R } 0 \\
18 \div 24 &= 0 \text{ R } 18 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{24} = 18000_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 8 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 9 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 23 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 23 &= 10818 \text{ R } 6 \times 23 + 14 = 1 \\
10818 \div 23 &= 466 \text{ R } 1 \text{ R } 18 \\
466 \div 23 &= 20 \text{ R } 6 \text{ R } 12 \\
20 \div 23 &= 0 \text{ R } 20 \\
\end{align*}
\]
So, \( 248832_{23} = 1618121_8 \) with a sum of digits \( 1 + 6 + 1 + 8 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 19 \), which is not 41.

For \( b = 22 \):
\[
\begin{align*}
248832 \div 22 &= 11310 \text{ R } 12 \times 22 + 0 = 1 \\
11310 \div 22 &= 514 \text{ R } 6 \times 22 + 14 = 1 \\
514 \div 22 &= 23 \text{ R } 12 \text{ R } 6 \\
23 \div 22 &= 1 \text{ R } 1 \\
1 \div 22 &= 0 \text{ R } 1 \\
\end{align*}
\]
The largest base \( b \) such that the sum of the digits of \( 248832_b \) is not 41 is \( 23 \).

\boxed{23}
